member: Sam — Structure, Mass and Material Handling Engineer
message:
Rear high-lift mast closes lift. Hopper pivot stowed at 0.45 metre (m) rising on 0.60 m vertical guide to 1.05 m pour lip, driven by 0.15 m stroke dual actuators through 4-to-1 chain at 0.80 friction efficiency. Linkage force 735 newton (N) for 15 kilogram (kg) raised load per actuator calc evidence E41, with input work 110 joule (J) per stroke-work calc evidence E42 against useful lift 88.3 J per useful-energy calc evidence E38, confirmed by 88.3 J recompute evidence E45. Prior 2400 J overhead is discarded because it timed motor run not static weight times rise, efficiency is 0.80 as expected.

Tip holds with stated geometry. Raised 15 kg at 0.30 m overhang aft of rear axle on 0.70 m wheelbase leaves 16.9 kg front-axle residual per residual-mass calc evidence E40, factor 4.66 per moment calc evidence E43. Earlier 7.1 versus 4.06 split is reconciled as moment-arm change, short overhang with no hopper versus long overhang, current 4.66 uses fixed 0.30 m overhang and lowered Center of Gravity (CG).

Stowed fit and mass close. Frame 0.95 m with 300 millimetre wheels, mast folded to 0.45 m, hopper lowered fits 1.0 by 0.5 by 0.5 m start box per dimensioned sketch evidence E44. Sortie 170 watt-hour (Wh) per sortie-energy calc evidence E32 replaces 1000 Wh error, pack 90.6 Wh per kg per pack-density calc evidence E34 gives about 5.3 kg pack for 53 kg joint total per reconciled-mass calc evidence E37 under 60 kg.
